title: Vladislav Ursu makes history in Moldovan table tennis!
excerpt: The European qualifying tournament for the Paris 2024 Olympic Games
body_html:
Vladislav URSU makes history in Moldovan table tennis!

Today, 19 May, Sarajevo hosted the next stage of the European qualifying tournament for the Paris 2024 Olympic Games.

On this day, ATTP’s most qualified and decorated member, Setka Cup ranking leader, International Master of Sport and one of the best table tennis players in Europe — Vladislav Ursu — made it firmly through to the final stage of the tournament and, deservedly, earned his accreditation for the Olympic Games.

The road to qualification was far from easy, and his opponents were strong — but not strong enough to get past Vladislav. After beating Greece’s S. Ioannis 4:1 and the Czech Lubomir Jancarik 4:0, he regrettably lost 1:4 to Slovakia’s Wang Yang (of Chinese origin) in the second round of qualifying. But in the 3rd and 4th rounds Vlad firmly won his matches against Slovakia’s Lubomir Pistej 4:0, Spain’s Alvaro Robles 4:3 and then Hungary’s Adam Szudi 4:0.

On this historic occasion, the National Sports Association ATTP sends its warmest congratulations to Vladislav Ursu, his family and his coach Vladimir Semipeadnîi on this remarkable and long-awaited achievement. For any athlete, qualifying for the Olympic Games — and, of course, the Olympic podium — is the highest goal of an entire career.

Vladislav Ursu’s name is already written into world sporting history, and we are convinced that the warmth of the Moldovan star that lit up the Olympic horizon today will warm the hearts of all table tennis fans in the Republic of Moldova for a long time to come.

Come on, Vlad Ursu!!!

Come on, Moldova!!!
